messages.text: How do changes in radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

What it does support is that automotive radar testing is covered as **automotive radar echo generation** with the R&S AREG800A, not as a signaling/non-signaling communications tester use case [2].
The radar-related capability changes documented for AREG800A include wider IF bandwidth options from **1 GHz** to **2 GHz** and **5 GHz**, second IF path activation, additional artificial objects, extended Doppler shift up to **10 MHz**, near-object FMCW range, analog IF interfaces, HIL control, and synchronization interfaces [5].
AREG800A radar production configurations also scale by digital channels, objects per channel, **5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth**, near-object range, and monostatic/bistatic frontend support [6].
Echo generation itself supports dynamic artificial objects, hybrid short-range analog delay plus long-range digital implementation up to **3000 m**, and FMCW digital echo generation [32].
By contrast, the R&S CMX500 is positioned as a radio communication tester for LTE/5G NR/WLAN signaling and measurements [1], [10], while the R&S CMP180 is positioned for WLAN production **non-signaling RF measurements**, including Wi‑Fi 7/5G NR FR1 up to **8 GHz**, bandwidths up to **500 MHz**, 2x2 MIMO, and scalable 4x4 MIMO testing [31].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 與既有知識的關係
本來源已對應既有來源頁 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] 與實體頁 [[R&S AREG800A]]。本次 ingest 依同一 raw source 重新校對既有頁面，補入或修正：

- [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 的 AUX IF output、RX power output、AUX IF input 與 connector 資訊。
- [[R&S QAT100]] 搭配 [[R&S AREG800A]] 的 IF level 與 amplitude flatness 摘要。
- 讀圖補充 p001、p021、p022、p023 的低可信度註記。
- `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` 條件、RF transfer characteristics 中未完整保留 option code 的 unresolved 記錄。

本來源與其他 Rohde & Schwarz Productions 頁面（如 [[R&S SGU100A]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]）同屬 test & measurement 產品資料，但用途為 automotive radar echo generation，不屬 RF signal generator 或 spectrum analyzer。

R&S AREG800A › Production base units
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

| 代碼 | 名稱 | Order No. | 原文的一句說明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| [[R&S AREG-DBP1]] | [[R&S AREG-P1]] radar mini | `1437.9676P02` | Production base unit option / radar mini configuration |
| [[R&S AREG-DBP2]] | [[R&S AREG-P2]] radar golden | `1437.9682P02` | Production base unit option / radar golden configuration |
| [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] | [[R&S AREG-P3]] radar pro | `1437.9699P02` | Production base unit option / radar pro configuration |

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S AREG800A]] — Automotive Radar Echo Generator；本來源主要產品實體。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] — 製造商與文件發布者。
- [[R&S AREG8-B9]] — Digital baseband，1 GHz IF bandwidth、1 IF path、1 individual artificial object；Order No. `1437.8011.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-B63]] — Analog stepped delay line，用於 short object generation；Order No. `1437.8205.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K527]] — Baseband extension from 1 GHz to 2 GHz IF bandwidth；Order No. `1437.9882.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K528]] — Baseband extension from 2 GHz to 5 GHz IF bandwidth；Order No. `1437.9799.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K570]] — Activation of second IF path；Order No. `1437.9899.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K812]] — One additional artificial object；Order No. `1437.9853.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K813]] — Extended Doppler frequency shift up to 10 MHz；Order No. `1437.9901.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K814]] — Near object range for FMCW；Order No. `1437.9776.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K740]] — Analog IF output interfaces；Order No. `1437.9830.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K741]] — Analog IF input interface；Order No. `1437.9847.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K109]] — Hardware-in-the-loop control interface；Order No. `1437.9860.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K549]] — Synchronization interface；Order No. `1437.9876.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-K986]] — Remote control GPIB；Order No. `1437.9818.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-B97]] — System alignment backend；Order No. `1437.9001.02`。
- [[R&S AREG-P1]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP1]]、[[R&S AREG-P2]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP2]]、[[R&S AREG-P3]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] — automotive radar production configurations / production base unit options。
- [[R&S AREG8-24S]]、[[R&S AREG8-24D]]、[[R&S AREG8-81S]]、[[R&S AREG8-81D]]、[[R&S AREG8-81WS]]、[[R&S AREG8-81WD]]、[[R&S FE44S]] — 支援的 mmWave 或 external frontends。
- [[R&S QAT100]]、[[R&S QAT-B2]]、[[R&S QAT-Z50]] — advanced antenna array 及其相關 option/accessory。

R&S AREG800A › Automotive radar production configurations
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- [[R&S AREG-P1]] radar mini configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP1]] base unit option：one digital channel，one object per channel，5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth，near object range possibility，analog IF output interfaces，remote control interfaces，[[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]] frontend option one frontend per channel required。
- [[R&S AREG-P2]] radar golden configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP2]] base unit option：two digital channels。
- [[R&S AREG-P3]] radar pro configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] base unit option：搭配 [[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]] frontend option；frontend 支援 monostatic 或 bistatic；three digital channels；one object per channel。

R&S SGU100A › Spectral purity
| 項目 | 條件 | 規格 |
|---|---|---|
| Harmonics | `f > 12 GHz, level ≤ 8 dBm` | `< –30 dBc` |

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

UL MIMO › 重點摘要
- [[PUSCH]] 可使用 [[UL MIMO]]，主要有 codebook-based 與 noncodebook-based 兩種版本。[[UL MIMO]]
- 這兩種方法適用於 dedicated UL DCI：[[DCI format 0_1]] 與 [[DCI format 0_2]]。[[UL MIMO]]
- 在 [[DCI format 0_1]] / [[DCI format 0_2]] 中，UE 透過 [[SRS resource indicator]] 與 [[Precoding information and number of layers]] 欄位識別 uplink precoder；欄位定義取決於 transmission scheme。[[UL MIMO]]
- 來源特別區分 transmit antenna ports、layers、SRS resources、DM-RS antenna ports 與 receive antennas；其中 layers 在來源敘述中等同於 [[DMRS antenna port]] 數。[[UL MIMO]]
- [[Codebook based uplink transmission]] 中，network 明確指示 UE 使用哪個 precoder，該資訊由 [[Precoding information and number of layers]] 欄位承載。[[UL MIMO]]
- [[Non-codebook based uplink transmission]] 中，network 不在 DCI 中建議 precoder，[[Precoding information and number of layers]] 欄位 bit length 為 0，UE autonomously 決定 precoder。[[UL MIMO]]
- Non-codebook operation 依來源需要 associated [[NZP CSI-RS]]，UE 可基於 associated NZP CSI-RS resource 的 measurement 計算 SRS transmission 使用的 precoder。[[UL MIMO]]
- Non-codebook 的 [[SRS resource indicator]] 用來指出實際使用哪些 SRS resources，因此也決定 SRS antenna ports 與 layers；來源列出 1、2、3、4 個 configured SRS ports 時 SRI values 對應的 antenna-port subsets。[[UL MIMO]]
- 來源在 DCI0_1/0_2 區段總結：codebook case 由 [[Precoding information and number of layers]] 決定 precoder 與 layer 數，[[SRS resource indicator]] 指出 UL antennas group；nonCodebook case 則由 [[Antenna ports]] 欄位定義 layer 數，[[SRS resource indicator]] 定義 SRS antenna ports 與特定 SRS antennas。[[UL MIMO]]

UL MIMO › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[UL MIMO]]：本來源主題，描述 PUSCH uplink MIMO 的 codebook / non-codebook transmission schemes。
- [[PUSCH]]：來源明示 PUSCH can use MIMO transmission。
- [[Codebook based uplink transmission]]：network 指示 UE precoder 的 uplink transmission scheme。
- [[Non-codebook based uplink transmission]]：UE autonomously 選擇 precoder 的 uplink transmission scheme。
- [[DCI format 0_1]]、[[DCI format 0_2]]：來源稱兩種 UL MIMO methods applicable for dedicated UL DCIs。
- [[SRS resource indicator]]：DCI 欄位，指示使用的 SRS resources / antenna ports subset。
- [[Precoding information and number of layers]]：codebook case 中承載 layer number 與 actual precoder 的 DCI 欄位；non-codebook case bit length 為 0。
- [[Antenna ports]]：non-codebook case 中定義 layer number 的欄位；也與 DM-RS type / length、scrambling sequences 相關。
- [[TPMI]]：Transmission Precoding Matrix Indication，來源說其 values 可見 [[3GPP TS 38.211]] Section 6.1.3.5。
- [[DMRS antenna port]]：來源將 number of layers 與 number of DM-RS antenna ports 視為相同。
- [[SRS resource set]]、[[SRS resource]]、[[SRS port]]：source 中 codebook / non-codebook preconditions 皆以 SRS-ResourceSet usage 與 SRS resources / ports 形式描述。
- [[NZP CSI-RS]]：來源說 non-codebook operation 需要 Non Zero Power CSI-RS，並且 UE 可基於 associated NZP CSI-RS resource 測量計算 precoder。
- [[3GPP TS 38.214]]：來源引用 Section 6.1.1.1 / 6.1.1.2。
- [[3GPP TS 38.212]]：來源引用 Tables 7.3.1.1.2-2 to 7.3.1.1.2-5 與 Tables 7.3.1.1.2-28 to 31。
- [[3GPP TS 38.211]]：來源引用 Section 6.1.3.5 與多個 TPMI tables。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：頁尾標示 company / copyright；本來源為 company confidential。

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。

- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。

Temporary UE capability restriction › 為什麼需要 capability restriction
依 [[Dual Sim Dual Active]]：

- dual-Tx / dual-Rx MUSIM device 可能為了有效與經濟地使用 hardware，在兩個 USIMs 之間 share hardware。
- dual active connections 可能造成 temporary hardware conflict。
- band conflict 也可能發生。
- UE 因此可能需要向 network report temporary capability restriction。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

answer.text:
What it does support is that automotive radar testing is covered as **automotive radar echo generation** with the R&S AREG800A, not as a signaling/non-signaling communications tester use case [2].
The radar-related capability changes documented for AREG800A include wider IF bandwidth options from **1 GHz** to **2 GHz** and **5 GHz**, second IF path activation, additional artificial objects, extended Doppler shift up to **10 MHz**, near-object FMCW range, analog IF interfaces, HIL control, and synchronization interfaces [5].
AREG800A radar production configurations also scale by digital channels, objects per channel, **5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth**, near-object range, and monostatic/bistatic frontend support [6].
Echo generation itself supports dynamic artificial objects, hybrid short-range analog delay plus long-range digital implementation up to **3000 m**, and FMCW digital echo generation [32].
By contrast, the R&S CMX500 is positioned as a radio communication tester for LTE/5G NR/WLAN signaling and measurements [1], [10], while the R&S CMP180 is positioned for WLAN production **non-signaling RF measurements**, including Wi‑Fi 7/5G NR FR1 up to **8 GHz**, bandwidths up to **500 MHz**, 2x2 MIMO, and scalable 4x4 MIMO testing [31].

- [[R&S AREG8-K986]] — Remote control GPIB；Order No. `1437.9818.02`。
- [[R&S AREG8-B97]] — System alignment backend；Order No. `1437.9001.02`。
- [[R&S AREG-P1]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP1]]、[[R&S AREG-P2]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP2]]、[[R&S AREG-P3]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] — automotive radar production configurations / production base unit options。
- [[R&S AREG8-24S]]、[[R&S AREG8-24D]]、[[R&S AREG8-81S]]、[[R&S AREG8-81D]]、[[R&S AREG8-81WS]]、[[R&S AREG8-81WD]]、[[R&S FE44S]] — 支援的 mmWave 或 external frontends。
- [[R&S QAT100]]、[[R&S QAT-B2]]、[[R&S QAT-Z50]] — advanced antenna array 及其相關 option/accessory。

R&S AREG800A › Automotive radar production configurations
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- [[R&S AREG-P1]] radar mini configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP1]] base unit option：one digital channel，one object per channel，5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth，near object range possibility，analog IF output interfaces，remote control interfaces，[[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]] frontend option one frontend per channel required。
- [[R&S AREG-P2]] radar golden configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP2]] base unit option：two digital channels。
- [[R&S AREG-P3]] radar pro configuration / [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] base unit option：搭配 [[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]] frontend option；frontend 支援 monostatic 或 bistatic；three digital channels；one object per channel。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。
